title: Paak Zainab Teri Rida Ton Warian Jadon Bawan Ghazi Nay
body:
Hasrat Day Naal Takiyah Ik Waar Khaimaya Nu
Fair Kai Kai Wari Bhariyan Hawan Ghazi Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
May Muhafiz Sah Par Rakh Sakeya Laaj Na Pehray Di
Rakiya Nai Zindagi Bhar Izataan Di Alhamad Day
Pairan Tai Naukaran Wangoo Nigawan Ghazi Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Teer Akhiyan Day Wich Kubgaye Nai Kuj Seenay Day Wich
Lath Gaiyan Dowain Baawan Aasan Di Mashk Dul Gai
Pani Wich Rurdiyan Ditiyan Wafawan Ghazi Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaak Karbal Di Payee Vain Paavai Mai Mualla Hogai
Meri Jholi Wich Sameya Marjaan Fatima Da
Menu Khoon Day Naal Nahi Ditiyan Shifawan Ghazi Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Kar Kay Zainab Day Khaimayan Nu Sajday Ronda Reya
Chadaran Day Raakhay Nu Kar Maaf Saain Daiveen
Shabeer Diyan Munn Laiyan Razawan Ghazi Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Jukh Gai Shah Di Kamar Bara Roya Pounch Kai Maqtal Wich
Zakhman Chon Raitaan Nu Mola Nay Saaf Kita
Fair Toriyan Jhooli Dai Wich Saawan Ghazi Nay
<<DIVIDER>>
Shimr Dai Goray Di Gardan Wich Sir See Ghazi Da
Kerbal Toun Shaam Taeen Rub Janay Samar Keevain
Bhena Nu Ro Ro Dasiyan Rawan Ghazi Nay
